description: Use for a quick view of a small organisation's cyber risk ('how secure are we?', 'what is our cyber risk score?'). Call without answers to get 15 weighted questions on access, data, systems, people, incident response and backups. Call with yes, partial or no per question to get a 0-100 score, a risk level and a score per category.

answers.description: Question id to answer, e.g. {"q1": "yes", "q4": "partial"}. Unanswered questions score zero.

name: cyber_risk_score
title: Cyber risk score (15 key controls)
